newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Chemunex to start Easdaq trading Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Chemunex to start Easdaq trading Tuesday.

text.p: French microbiology firm Chemunex will begin trading on Europe's fledgling growth stocks market Easdaq on Tuesday, the Brussels-based stock exchange said in a statement.
The company is being launched through an international offering of 4.5 million new ordinary shares, priced at 18.00 French francs each, which will raise 81 million francs.
Chemunex's president Louis Foissac said last week the listing operation also involved 70 million francs worth of existing shares.

The company, which is expected to have a market capitalisation of about 425 million francs ($75 million), will be the eighth stock to be listed on the pan-European exchange, and the first not to be quoted in dollars.
Chemunex develops and markets very sensitive rapid testing systems for microbial contamination, mainly for the pharmaceutical, water and food industries.
The listing of Chemunex brings the amount of capital raised on Easdaq since trading began in November last year to about $343 million, and takes total market capitalisation to $1.45 billion.
